Papyrus writing in ancient Egypt
Plant — Cyperus papyrus
Sheet — layered stalk pith, dried under pressure
Recto — inner surface of roll, horizontal fibers
Verso — outer surface of roll
Scripts — hieratic, demotic, Greek, Coptic
- The Metropolitan Museum of Art
provenance: Factual material, surface and script data. Janice Kamrin, Papyrus in Ancient Egypt, The Metropolitan Museum of Art (2015). https://www.metmuseum.org/essays/papyrus-in-ancient-egypt . Checked 2026-10-22. No museum prose or images reproduced.

Water

Papyrus manufacture in ancient Egypt
Stalk bundles — skiffs
Pith strips — writing sheets, mats, boxes, baskets, lids, sandals, ropes
Reused writing sheets and plaster — cartonnage
